{"text":"How many cents per mile are staff reimbursed for driving their own car on business?","why":"A staff question the handbook is meant to answer."}
{"text":"For how many years are signed contracts kept after they expire?","why":"A staff question the handbook is meant to answer."}
{"text":"Within how many hours must a priority-one support ticket get a first response?","why":"A staff question the handbook is meant to answer."}

{"citation":"Lumen Fold Studios staff handbook, section S1, as given to jon.","passage":"Permanent employees give 12 weeks' notice of resignation. Staff still on probation give 1 week.","reliability":"The copy of the handbook jon was given."}

{"citation":"Lumen Fold Studios staff handbook, section S2, as given to jon.","passage":"Mezzanine shelving is rated for 150 kg per bay. No single item over 25 kg may go on the top shelf.","reliability":"The copy of the handbook jon was given."}

{"citation":"Lumen Fold Studios staff handbook, section S3, as given to jon.","passage":"Signed contracts are kept for 3 years after they expire. Unsigned drafts are deleted after 6 months.","reliability":"The copy of the handbook jon was given."}
